selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific botanical classification and rule out look-alikes like zucchini or gourds.
To check for edge bleeding between the smooth cucumber skin and the complex background foliage, and to verify the connectivity of the stem/flower attachments.
To assess overall coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies in the leaves and soil.

focus_areas: Attachment point of the yellow flower to the cucumber tip (check for fusion/melting).
Boundary sharpness between the cucumber rind and the surrounding leaves.
Structural logic of the vine tendrils in the background.
Texture consistency of the cucumber skin (smooth vs. bumpy).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection between the yellow flower and the cucumber tip. AI often struggles with this specific attachment, resulting in melting or ambiguous geometry. Also, verify if the 'smoothness' of the cucumber is realistic or if it looks like plastic/shiny material due to over-smoothing artifacts.
